# Frozen sample compatibility fixtures

Both fixtures use the same five synthetic books and 51 repeated tags. They were
generated before the versioned compatibility implementation, not by its replay code.

- `sample-v1-released.json`: generated by `story_rank.py` at Git commit
  `098bec6` (published v0.6.22); source SHA-256
  `76e0ac701b519cb66d31b78b4bc3d94bb488ef04fd7e1119b12ebbe09b4d892e`.
  Top-50 repeated-tag selection chooses books `1, 2`.
- `sample-v1-full-tags.json`: generated by the pre-versioning development source;
  source SHA-256 `a87fa2605d8f46f30dd216c1146d4ee474709de75747b5dc7da5db4b2dd993cb`.
  Full-group repeated-tag selection chooses books `1, 4`.
- `decision-v1-released.json`: created by the same released rank module and
  released `story_research.py` (source SHA-256
  `72f858596e2604e61789f18121d536b5ec9d242bf4032d251457eede8e9fce84`).
  Includes one frozen verification using explicitly unverified example URLs.

Do not regenerate these files from the current implementation. Their complete
records and sample IDs are historical evidence for compatibility tests. These
are offline algorithm fixtures, not real rankings or reader research.
